script.problem: Moment 2's passage Acts 18:4-7 doesn't include a verse that names Corinth in the lessons.

terra.problem: “Teaching in the Synagogue” says Paul told Jews and Greeks that Jesus is the Christ every Sabbath. Acts 18:4 says he reasoned with Jews and Greeks every Sabbath; verse 5 says he testified to the Jews that Jesus is the Christ.

“A Letter to the Church,” “A Second Letter of Comfort,” and “Why Paul Did Not Return” describe things Paul wrote to Corinth, not events shown happening there. The cited passages do not place Paul in Corinth when he wrote them.
